title: Tian Guan Cifu Er
synopsis:
Although most gods in the heavenly realm avoid dealing with the forgotten god Xie Lian, Heavenly Emperor Jun Wu holds him in good graces. Xie Lian's luck is otherwise terrible, and adding to his troubles, the gods seem to suspect that Xie Lian's recent companion was the dreaded Ghost King Hua Cheng. Despite what others may think of him, Xie Lian fondly recalls Hua Cheng's promise: the next time they meet, Hua Cheng will appear in his true form.

Jun Wu informs Xie Lian of the unsettling news that a god's distress signal was seen coming from the Ghost City—the most prosperous place in the ghost realm, where the only law is Hua Cheng himself. As Xie Lian has no qualms about stepping into Hua Cheng's territory, he infiltrates the city to locate the lost god. There, the genuine Hua Cheng is already waiting. He is the most feared being across the three realms, yet before Xie Lian, his arrogance erodes. Without revealing the reason for his generosity, he spares no power or means to ease the burdens of Xie Lian's endlessly unfortunate past.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

episodes_data.title: The Ghost King Appears
episodes_data.description: Xie Lian is summoned by Jun Wu to the Heavenly Realm where he`s informed that a Heavenly Official needs to be rescued, so he goes to the Ghost Realm, the territory of the dead.

episodes_data.title: Accidentally Entered a Gambling Den
episodes_data.description: The Martial God of the East, Lang Qianqiu, causes a commotion in the ghost king`s gambling hall, forcing Xie Lian to play a dice game against the king himself, Hua Cheng, to save his comrade.

episodes_data.title: Ghost Binding Cursed Shackle
episodes_data.description: A masked ghost leads Xie Lian to the Paradise Manor, where Hua Cheng is waiting for him. Later on, Xie Lian meets the bandaged boy from Yu Jun Mountain again and recalls a similar boy he met eight hundred years ago.

episodes_data.title: The Secret Chamber
episodes_data.description: After infiltrating Paradise Manor and using a mysterious door granting access to various spaces depending on dice rolls, Xie Lian and Shi Qingxuan eventually reach the underground dungeon, where they discover the missing Heavenly Official.

episodes_data.title: The Second Coming of Fang Xin
episodes_data.description: Back in the Heavenly Realm, Lang Qianqiu confronts Xie Lian about the true identity of the State Preceptor of Yong`an kingdom, Fang Xin, who massacred Yong`an`s nobility and killed Lang Qianqiu`s father, the king.

episodes_data.title: Heavenly Palace Raid
episodes_data.description: Acknowledging his position as the State Preceptor, Xie Lian is apprehended and put under house arrest. He reflects on his haunted past before the doors of the Palace of Xianle are kicked open and silver butterflies swarm in.

episodes_data.title: A Thousand Miles Away
episodes_data.description: Hua Cheng leads Xie Lian away from the Heavenly Realm. Meanwhile, Feng Xin and Mu Qing encounter many obstacles while attempting to rescue him, and Lang Qianqiu has a plan of his own.

episodes_data.title: The Green-Clothed Ghost Qi Rong
episodes_data.description: Xie Lian and Hua Cheng enter the lair of the Night-Touring Green Lantern, Qi Rong. After a brief, violent confrontation, Qi Rong reveals the truth about the Yong`an massacre but other surprising truths are also told.

episodes_data.title: Yong An and Xian Le
episodes_data.description:
Hua Cheng loses his composure and begins to violently assault Qi Rong. Qi Rong gives in and reveals the truth about the massacre at the Golden Feast...
The truth is revealed about what happened in Yong An, which was supposed to have been heading towards peace, just before Lang Qianqiu was about to have his 17th Birthday...

episodes_data.title: Bloodstained Banquet
episodes_data.description: An Le, a descendant of the imperial house of the fallen kingdom of Xian Le, was left in charge of preparations for the Golden Feast by the ruler of Yong An. While on the surface, An Le was a good friend to the Yong An Imperial Family, there was a darkness in his heart that Qi Rong took advantage of. When Fangxin (Xie Lian) arrives late to the banquet, he encounters something shocking, and is forced to make a choice...

episodes_data.title: A Sad Parting Under Moonlight
episodes_data.description: Xie Lian gets angry with Hua Cheng for revealing the truth about the Golden Feast Massacre to Lang Qianqiu. But Hua Cheng tells him plainly that Xie Lian did nothing wrong. When he realizes that Hua Cheng trusts him absolutely, and is the one person to see through to the truth of the matter, he says aloud that he wonders if they`ve met somewhere before...

episodes_data.title: May All Taboos Be Shattered
episodes_data.description: Xie Lian returns to the Heavenly Capital and tells Junwu the truth about the banquet massacre. The events have made Xie Lian trust Hua Cheng even more, but Junwu feels even more suspicious of him. Xie Lian leaves heaven and heads to the ruins of Xian Le. As he goes to see his parents` coffin, someone is waiting for him...
